Tata Power Renewable Energy Limited (TPREL) also executed 131.2 MWhr (megawatt hour) of storage projects during the second quarter of FY27, the company said in a statement. During the first half of FY27, the company commissioned several key projects, including the 100.8-MW Jewali Wind Project, the Kalasar FDRE Project comprising 227.5 MW of solar capacity and a 101.2-MWhr Battery Energy Storage System (BESS), the 100 MW Kayathar Group Captive Project, and the 72.5-MW Tata Steel Captive Project. entries.summary: The Supreme Court rules public servants must explain wealth exceeding known income once prosecution establishes a disproportionate-assets case against them.
entries.title: Accused must explain source of excess wealth, not investigators: Supreme Court

entries.summary: Bengaluru-built, San Francisco-headquartered CPA firm Inkle has acquired Finally's bookkeeping division in an undisclosed all-cash deal, taking its team to about 160 people across five countries and extending it from startups to non-tech small businesses.
entries.title: Bengaluru-based Inkle acquires Finally’s bookkeeping arm, expands team to 160
